blockbuster.config.video.title: Video recording
blockbuster.config.video.tooltip: Blockbuster's built-in video recorder (replaces the Minema mod of 1.12.2). Shift+F4 opens the recording panel
blockbuster.config.comments.video.resolu: Size of the recorded video. The world is rendered at this size whatever the window size (also with shaders). Window size = record what the window shows
blockbuster.config.comments.video.debug: Write detailed recorder diagnostics to latest.log (readback timings every 120 frames)
blockbuster.config.comments.video.ffmpeg: Path to ffmpeg: the executable, its folder, or just "ffmpeg" when it is on the PATH. Without a working ffmpeg, videos are saved as PNG sequences
blockbuster.config.comments.video.argume: ffmpeg arguments used when Encoding is "Custom". Placeholders: %WIDTH%, %HEIGHT%, %FPS%, %FILTERS%, %NAME%, %PIX_FMT%
Same as the custom arguments, with the scene audio as a second input (%AUDIO_TRACK%)
ffmpeg arguments for transparent recordings (needs an alpha-capable format, ProRes 4444 by default)
Transparent recording arguments with the scene audio (%AUDIO_TRACK%)
blockbuster.config.comments.video.width: Video width in pixels. 0 = the window's width. The video is rendered at this size whatever the window size
blockbuster.config.comments.video.height: Video height in pixels. 0 = the window's height. Odd values are rounded down to even
blockbuster.config.comments.video.frame_: Frames per second of the video. Recording is frame by frame: the game may run slower, the video does not
blockbuster.config.comments.video.motion: Motion blur level: 0 = off, N renders 2^N frames per output frame and blends them
blockbuster.config.comments.video.held_f: Number of rendered frames per output frame (1 = every frame)
blockbuster.config.comments.video.alpha: Record with a transparent sky (alpha channel), into a ProRes 4444 .mov or a PNG sequence
blockbuster.config.comments.video.audio: Add the scene's audio track to the video
blockbuster.config.comments.video.export: Folder videos are written to. Empty = config/blockbuster/movies
blockbuster.config.comments.video.encode: Write one ffmpeg log per recording (<name>.log) instead of a shared video.log
blockbuster.config.comments.video.custom: With an Iris shader pack, render the world at the chosen video resolution (recommended). Off = render at the window size and scale
blockbuster.config.comments.video.encode: x264 = the 1.12.2 settings (H.264, quality 18). x264_hq = quality 10 for heavy editing. nvenc = NVIDIA GPU encoder (needs a recent driver). custom = your own ffmpeg arguments
blockbuster.video.msg.scaled: The window (%s×%s) is rendered at its own size and scaled to the video size: %s
blockbuster.video.msg.cropped: The window (%s×%s) has an odd size: one pixel is cropped. Reason: %s
blockbuster.video.msg.resized: The window changed size (%s×%s) during the take: frames are scaled to keep the video at %s×%s
blockbuster.video.msg.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg cannot be run (%s): recording as a PNG sequence instead. Check the ffmpeg path in the video settings
blockbuster.video.msg.no_ffmpeg_join: ffmpeg cannot be run (%s): videos will be recorded as PNG sequences. Check the ffmpeg path in the video settings
blockbuster.video.msg.shader_chroma: Green screen sky is on, but the shader pack draws its own sky: this recording will not be keyable
blockbuster.video.msg.shader_alpha: Transparent recording is on, but the shader pack writes the alpha channel: it will be opaque
blockbuster.video.reason.shaders_option: the chosen resolution with shaders is disabled in the video settings
blockbuster.video.reason.driver: the graphics card refused a framebuffer of that size

blockbuster.config.screenshot.tooltip: Blockbuster's transparent screenshots (port addition; 1.12.2 Blockbuster had no screenshot feature at all)
blockbuster.config.comments.screenshot.t: Enable Blockbuster's transparent screenshots: an RGBA PNG grabbed after the world is drawn but before the HUD, so no GUI is in the frame. Turn off and both triggers below do nothing — the mod stays out of the screenshot path entirely
blockbuster.config.comments.screenshot.r: Let the vanilla screenshot key (F2) take the transparent screenshot instead of an ordinary one, so you don't have to bind Blockbuster's own key. Only in-world with no screen open — F2 in a menu, on the title screen, or in the model editor keeps working as before. Off = F2 is untouched
blockbuster.config.comments.screenshot.e: Folder transparent screenshots are written to. Empty = screenshots/blockbuster

blockbuster.commands.modelblock.property: §rChanges model block property §7<property>§r to §7<value>§r of a model block at §7<x>§r, §7<y>§r, §7<z>§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.help: §r§oRecord command§r. This command provides few sub-commands for manipulating player recording actions.
blockbuster.commands.model.help: §r§oModel command§r. This command provides sub-commands for managing custom models.
blockbuster.commands.record.remove_all: §rRemoves all actions in player recording by §7<filename>§r
blockbuster.commands.action.append: §rRecords an action from current player into given §7<filename>§r with §7<offset>§r tick which will overwrite given frames after given offset tick. You can also optionally specify §7[scene]§r name. Supplying scene name, helps out with synchronizing the actors.
blockbuster.commands.record.dupe: §rThis command duplicates given §7<filename>§r player recording to a new player recording file with given §7<new_filename>§r. §7[overwrite]§r is §7false§r by default, specify §7true§r if you want to overwrite an existing recording
blockbuster.commands.record.delete: §rDeletes the recording file by §7<filename>§r. If you specify §7[force]§r as true, you'll skip confirmation process.
blockbuster.commands.record.merge: §rMerge actions from §7<source>§r into §7<destination>§r. When you set §7[morph_only]§r to §7true§r, the command will only merge morph actions.
blockbuster.commands.record.restore: §rRestores previous version §7<iteration>§r of a player recording by name §7<filename>§r. For example §7/record restore test 1§r will swap §7test.dat§r and §7test.dat~1§r player recording files places.
blockbuster.commands.record.remove_modal: Are you sure you want to remove the actions at the given tick?
blockbuster.commands.action.request: §rRequests an action, named §7<filename>§r, to be loaded from server to current client.
blockbuster.commands.record.clean: §rThis command cleans given §7<property>§r in §7<filename>§r player recording from §7[from]§r tick to §7[to]§r (not including §7[to]§r) tick to the value specified either in §7[value]§r argument (it accepts relative values) or the value at frame §7[from]§r or the first frame.
blockbuster.commands.model.clear_structu: §rClears the structure morphs cache and reloads all of the structures.
blockbuster.commands.record.info: §rOutputs information about player recording by filename §7<filename>§r, such as saved version of record format, length of the record, etc.
blockbuster.commands.record.prolong: §rThis command allows to specify a pre and post delay for given §7<filename>§r player recording.
blockbuster.commands.modelblock.help: §r§oModel block command§r. This command allows editing model blocks through commands.
blockbuster.commands.modelblock.morph: §rChanges morph to §7[morph_nbt]§r of a model block at §7<x>§r, §7<y>§r, §7<z>§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.add: §rAdds an action to player recording by §7<filename>§r at §7<tick>§r of type §7<action_type>§r with additional data specified in §7[data_tag]§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.remove_body_: §rRemoves body yaw properties from given player recording.
blockbuster.commands.model.combine: §rCreates combination of textures specified in §7<paths...>§r (relative to §7config/blockbuster/models/§r) into single skins, and exports them to §7config/blockbuster/export/§r.
blockbuster.commands.damage.help: §rInflicts §7<amount>§r damage to §7<entity>§r. If §7<amount>§r is negative then all §7<entity>§r matched by target selector will be healed.
blockbuster.commands.action.clear: §rRemoves all records on the client (used to force unload client-side records).
blockbuster.commands.action.help: §r§oAction command§r. This command provides few sub-commands for managing player recording actions.
blockbuster.commands.record.remove_all_m: Are you sure you want to remove all actions in the recording "%s"?
blockbuster.commands.record.remove: §rRemoves all actions on §7<tick>§r in player recording by §7<filename>§r. If you'll specify §7[index]§r, command will remove only one action in §7<tick>§r at §7[index]§r. §7[index]§r of -1 deletes all actions in §7<tick>§r. If you specify §7[force]§r as true, you'll skip confirmation process.
blockbuster.commands.item_nbt.help: §rItem NBT command allows to copy current held item's NBT tag to the clipboard. If you provide §7<give_command>§r as §7true§r or §71§r it will copy to clipboard a proper §7/give§r command to give that item. You'll most likely need a command block for that...
blockbuster.commands.action.play: §rPlaybacks an action from given §7<filename>§r. This sub-command also can receive optional arguments §7[invincibility]§r flag (§71§r, §70§r, §7true§r or §7false§r values) and §7[morph_nbt]§r (which allows to specify a morph).
blockbuster.commands.scene: §rStart, stop or toggle playback of scene by §7<name>§r. There is also §7loop§r which allow to change looping with §7[flag]§r argument (§7true§r or §7false§r).
blockbuster.commands.record.cut: §rThis command removes all actions in player recording §7<filename>§r before §7<before>§r and after §7<after>§r (pre and post delays shouldn't be taken into account giving §7<from>§r and §7<to>§r arguments).
blockbuster.commands.record.reverse: §rReverses the order of frames and actions in the player recording by name §7<filename>§r.
blockbuster.commands.model.convert: §rConverts a skin §7<skin>§r (name filename without extension in §7<steve|fred>§r model) 64x64 (§7fred§r) to 64x32 or 64x32 (§7steve§r) to 64x64 skin.
blockbuster.commands.record.fill: §rThis command inserts §7<count>§f frames at §7[tick]§f in §7<filename>§r player recording. If §7[tick]§r is not provided, it would use the length of given player recording.
blockbuster.commands.model.reload: §rForces the client and server to reload models (server-side only for OP users) with optional §7[force]§r argument which if is §7true§r will reload all models surpassing cached non-modified files timestamp.
blockbuster.commands.record.erase: §rThis command removes §7<count>§r actions in player recording §7<filename>§r starting at tick §7<from>§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.fade: §rThis command fades out §7<filename>§r player recording to the first frame using linear interpolation that fades §7<fade_out>§r ticks.
blockbuster.commands.model.export_obj: §rConverts Blockbuster JSON model named §7<model_name>§r to OBJ (along side with default texture, if present, and MTL file). Exported OBJ model can be found in Blockbuster's config §lexport§r folder.
blockbuster.commands.record.process:
§rThis command processes given §7<property>§r in §7<filename>§r player recording from §7<from>§r tick to §7<to>§r and applies given §7<math>§r expression. Following variables are available:

§7initial§r - initial value of given property
§7value§r - current value of given property
§7tick§r - currently processing frame's tick
§7from§r - §7<from>§r argument
§7to§r - §7<to>§r argument
§7factor§r - how far into the processing the expression between §7from§r and §7to§r is (0..1), the formula for it is basically §7(tick - from) / (to - from)§r
blockbuster.commands.record.create: §rThis command creates a player recording named §7<filename>§r with §7<duration>§r frames. §7[x]§r, §7[y]§r, §7[z]§r, §7[yaw]§r, and §7[pitch]§r can be optionally specified to override current sender's position and rotation (relative §7~§r values are supported).
blockbuster.commands.record.get: §rOutputs data tag of action found at §7<tick>§r in player recording by filename §7<filename>§r.
blockbuster.commands.model.report: §rThis command creates a report about which models and skins are present, and which loaded by Minecraft, and copies it to the copy-paste buffer. This command is for assistance purposes only.
blockbuster.commands.on_head.help: §r§oOn head command§r. This command allows putting currently held item in the main slot directly in the head slot, without any hassle of coming up with NBT data tag.
blockbuster.commands.spectate.help: §r§oSpectate command§r. This command allows making given §7<player>§r to spectate given §7<entity>§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.apply:
§rApplies §7<source>§r's frames list of §7<properties>§r (can be separated by §7,§r) on §7<target>§r player recording. Optionally you can specify whether frame properties will be applied §7[relative]§r (by default absolutely), and you can specify the range from §7[from]§r to §7[to]§r ticks.

Additionally special types like §7head
blockbuster.commands.record.flip: §rThis command flips frames and actions of §7<filename>§r player recording across given §7<axis>§r at given §7<coordinate>§r. Set §7[center]§r to §7false§r (by default it's §7true§r) if you're mirroring across even number of blocks thick wall.
blockbuster.commands.record.delete_modal: Are you sure you want to delete the "%s" recording file?
blockbuster.commands.mount.help:
§r§oMount command§r. This command allows making given §7<target>§r entity to mount a given §7[destination]§r entity. If §7[destination]§r is omitted, then the §7<target>§r will be dismounted.

Make sure there are only one entity that is qualifies for §7<target>§r and §7[destination]§r target selectors!
blockbuster.commands.record.search: §rSearches for actions, optionally limited by §7[limit]§r, of given §7<action_type>§r and outputs the tick and, optionally output data tag, found in player recording by filename §7<filename>§r.
blockbuster.commands.action.record: §rRecords an action from current player into given §7<filename>§r. You can also optionally specify §7[scene]§r name. Supplying scene name, helps out with synchronizing the actors.
blockbuster.commands.record.tp: §rThis command teleports player to first frame or frame at §7[tick]§r frame, if specified, §7<filename>§r player recording.
blockbuster.commands.record.camera: §rGenerates a new (or updates exisitng) player recording named §7<filename>§r using the the data from server side §7<camera_profile>§r. Optional offset §7[x]§r, §7[y]§r and §7[z]§r can be provided that will shift the position by given XYZ offset.
blockbuster.commands.action.stop: §rStops the recording of action. If the player didn't record anything, nothing will happen.
blockbuster.commands.record.rename: §rThis command renames given §7<filename>§r player recording to a new name §7<new_filename>§r. It also renames past versions of the §7<filename>§r player recording, if there are any.
blockbuster.commands.model.clear: §rClears the texture cache from loaded Blockbuster's skin textures. If §7[path]§r specified, the command will only clear the textures which begins with §7[path]§r.
blockbuster.commands.model.export:
§rExports model from §7<entity_name>§r mob renderer in JSON format that actor use for custom models. This model will be exported into export folder of Blockbuster's config folder. Optionally you can provide §7[entity_tag]§r to generate a model from entity with specific data.

§r§lAttention§r: those models are automatically generated and aren't perfect. You'll need to adjust those models in McME to get best result.
blockbuster.commands.record.calculate_bo: §rAutomatically calculates body yaw for given player recording§r.
blockbuster.commands.record.origin: §rThis command changes the origin (the first frame) of the player recording according to §7[x] [y] [z]§r (if all three were specified) or player's current position. You might also rotate the player recording across Y axis relative to its first frame.
blockbuster.config.comments.snowstorm.de: When enabled is fixes the particles being seen behind other semi-transparent particles. This option is very performance intensive, consider it using only when rendering video footage
blockbuster.config.comments.audio.wavefo: Height of an audio bar in pixels
Whether filename of the played audio in the audio should be shown
Width of an audio bar in floating point percentage (between 0 and 1)
blockbuster.config.comments.audio.audio_: Whether the audio should always try to sync between server and client. This does not affect the playback and syncing when rejoining on a server with running audio. This option is for starting audio playback while being on the server. This configuration is a server side option.
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: This option enabled preview of animated morphs like image morph animations, animated poses, record morphs and sequencers. It's affects performance of the server side.
blockbuster.config.comments.audio.wavefo: Whether audio bars should be shown when they're playing back
blockbuster.config.comments.actor.actor_: Make actor always rendered, no matter where it is or its hitbox size
blockbuster.config.comments.damage_contr: Radius of effect for damage control
Render the path of models if they are missing. They will always render in F3 mode.
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: How long does it take to unload a record (in ticks)
blockbuster.config.comments.onion_skin.m: Display the previous morph during editing
blockbuster.config.comments.scenes.save_: Whether scenes should be reloaded, if running, after saving the scene by exiting the dashboard GUI.
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: Does attack action get recorded with swipe action?
blockbuster.config.comments.actor.actor_: Makes actors use correct Y value (fixes issue with hovering and jumping, but makes Y movement sharp)
blockbuster.config.comments.model_folder: Absolute path to additional model Folder (on windows add the drive letter)
blockbuster.config.comments.immersive_ed: Whether to use the immersive editor for model block
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: Enable the rendering of recording debug paths.
When enabled, once a scene starts playing all playback, all model blocks will reset themselves
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: Prefix which will get prepended to the actual message in the chat action (%%NAME%% wild card supported for current actor's name)
blockbuster.config.comments.general.bb_g: If it's greater than 0, this option enables BB gun projectile synchronization, which makes projectile sync with the server, but at the cost of jittery teleportation
blockbuster.config.comments.actor.actor_: How far actors are tracked? Requires restart of the game.
Render the debug cube of model blocks while being in F1 mode, alongside F3 mode.
blockbuster.config.comments.recording.re: How often a recording is going to synchronize with the server?
blockbuster.config.comments.audio.wavefo: How many pixels of audio waveform should be shown per second
Whether model blocks should be rendered
blockbuster.config.comments.general.debu: Write ticks in the log during scene playback
blockbuster.config.comments.actor.actor_: Whether separate recorded horizontal body rotation should be played back on the actor (this guarantees consistent body rotation how it was recorded, it works only on new recordings recorded on Blockbuster 2.1+)
blockbuster.config.comments.general.gree: Specifies the sky color for chroma sky feature
blockbuster.config.comments.general.show: Whether first time modal should be shown in the dashboard
blockbuster.config.comments.audio.wavefo: Whether audio track's playback time should be displayed. Keep in mind that audio track's playback time doesn't necessarily represent scene's current playback time!
blockbuster.config.comments.damage_contr: Displays a warning if the currently pointed block has been managed by damage control
blockbuster.config.comments.actor.actor_: Disable an option to being able to ride the actor by right clicking it
